_readme: Cloudflare Access policy for the Singapore Transit Atlas. This file is the intended state; infra/apply_access.py pushes it to Cloudflare. Spec: specs/011-access-email-login/. NOT ACTIVE — see docs/access-setup.md.
_hostname_note: The atlas hostname, e.g. atlas.moovemedia.com.sg. Must be a zone on Cloudflare DNS. Access CANNOT be placed in front of a github.io address, so a custom domain is a hard prerequisite. apply_access.py refuses to run while this is the placeholder.

application.name: Singapore Transit Atlas
application._path_note: Empty path = the entire hostname, data/*.json included. Gating only part of the app would leave the data files publicly fetchable, which is the whole point of doing this at the edge rather than in index.html.
application._session_note: A working day. Long enough that a seller signs in once each morning rather than mid-pitch; short enough that a borrowed laptop is not open indefinitely.
application._idp_note: One-time PIN: Cloudflare emails a code to the address entered. No account, no directory, no invitation — which is what makes FR-003 (a new starter gets in unaided) achievable.

policies.name: Moove Media staff
policies._include_note: The domain is the credential, and it is the only one Moove uses — confirmed 2026-08-27. Local part is irrelevant: v_msaifulma@moovemedia.com.sg matches like any other. There are no subdomain variants to admit, so this single rule is the whole policy.

policies.name: Named exceptions
policies._exceptions_note: Individual addresses admitted one at a time — a contractor, an agency partner. Kept as its own policy so admitting one person never means widening the domain rule. Empty by design; every addition should be reviewable in a diff with a reason in the commit message.

service_tokens.name: atlas-headless-checks
service_tokens._note: Non-interactive path for the project's headless verification, so activating this does not break Principle V's evidence requirement. Cloudflare issues a client ID and secret on creation; they go in the environment of whatever runs the checks and NEVER in this repository.
